## Change summary

Explain the risk/problem and the smallest change that addresses it.

## Mandatory review

- [ ] Financial invariants remain valid
- [ ] Ledger and audit-chain impact reviewed
- [ ] Idempotency/replay/concurrency impact reviewed
- [ ] Authentication, privileged roles and dual-control impact reviewed
- [ ] PII/LGPD and encryption impact reviewed
- [ ] Flyway/schema compatibility reviewed
- [ ] Provider/webhook/reconciliation impact reviewed
- [ ] Failure, retry and rollback behavior reviewed
- [ ] Tests cover positive and negative paths
- [ ] No credentials, real financial data or sensitive PII committed
- [ ] Real-money/PIX/custody/settlement NO-GO remains unchanged unless external gate evidence is explicitly approved

## Evidence

Link the relevant test, workflow, rehearsal, metric or artifact that proves the control.
